cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Take the Consequence
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility for carrying out the cost, penalty, or unpleasant next step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said you'd announce the budget cut if your plan cost more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the announcement short, then. I'll help with the wording.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll write the explanation and rehearse it with you. You're still the one who tells them.

reason: A uses the explanation skill B invokes as support, not substitution, preserving the unpleasant promised announcement.
